title: silicone tongs
text:
silicone tongs. UPDATE BELOW...You get a set of two... I was hoping the "silicone" coating would have been softer, but it is very, very hard. I hope they will not start melting or flaking off. I guess time will tell. I will update my review should new info seem useful. At this time, until I have used them for a longer period of time, I don't think I can fully recommend these.
UPDATE 2/1/2021... I have been using the smaller of the set fairly regularly. I do not see any flaking or melting. I do handwash them. I think more time needs to pass but I am raising my review up 1 star.

product_metadata.title: HOTEC Premium Stainless Steel Locking Kitchen Tongs with Silicon Tips, Set of 2-9" and 12"
features: TOP QUALITY: Hotec kitchen tongs are constructed with high quality stainless steel, sturdy, heat resistance, anti-rust, anti-corrosion, light weight, easy to handle, like new forever. This tongs for cooking comes with 2 sizes, 9 inch and 12 inch.

EASY TO STORE: These kitchen tongs have locking mechanism, pull the ring for lock and push for unlock, super easy operation. Hang them with the hanging loop after use or put in the drawer by pulling the ring to lock it, space saving.

ENGINEERING FOR SAFETY: Updated new design pattern for the handle, better protects your hands from cutting by the edge when you grip the handle. Easy to control the handle and to eliminate wobbling & any risk of burning your hands

EASY TO USE: The handle is cushioned with silicon, good for thumb rest and ensures good grip and control. The silicon tong tip is heat resistance and less prone to scratch the pan. Easy to rinse, dishwasher safe.

MULTIPLE APPLICATIONS: Basic kitchen utensil, perfect for basic kitchen tasks, indoor or outdoor use, great for grilling corn, flipping burgers, serving salad, cutting roast meat, or used as BBQ turners and much more.
